newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler buys heavy truck business from Ford.
newsitem.headline: Daimler buys heavy truck business from Ford.

text.p: German industrial group Daimler-Benz AG said on Wednesday that its U.S. truck subsidiary Freightliner has purchased the heavy truck business of Ford Motor Co.

Daimler said both companies have agreed to the deal under which Ford will turn over production, research and development of its "HN80" truck to Freightliner. The deal also calls for Freightliner to take over production of Ford's L-Series trucks and Ford cargo trucks.
The Ford vehicles are sold in the United States, Canada and Australia, Daimler said in a statement.
Daimler buys heavy truck business from Ford =2

The statement also said that Ford would remain in the light and mid-sized truck markets while Freightliner gains additional market share in the 8 to 15 tonne vehicle market for construction and distribution trucks.
Freightliner, which is based in Portland, Oregon, and was acquired in 1981, said the Ford deal would push its annual revenues to more than one billion marks.
